cards.card_text: He has seen how severely the Egyptians are oppressing them.
cards.verse_text: And now the cry of the Israelites has reached Me, and I have seen how severely the Egyptians are oppressing them.
cards.snippet: …has reached Me, and I have seen how severely the Egyptians are oppressing them.

cards.card_text: Solomon names two things: oppressing the poor to enrich oneself, or giving gifts to the rich.
cards.verse_text: Oppressing the poor to enrich oneself or giving gifts to the rich will surely lead to poverty.
